method: Read-only original STL strict canonical-edge XY sections. Degree2 and original loop/combined validity asserted; no repair. Named feature masks locate intersections only. Root overlaps report all actual components and areas. Lateral corridors report exact section occupancy plus two-direction parity controls.
limitations: Vertical-overlap area is not support-free printability or load-bearing strength.
The upper rails bridge separate posts; multiple root patches are expected and not disguised as one root.
Nominal source-derived masks locate the feature; numerical metrics come from actual STL intersections. No mask-clipped polygon replaces an original polygon in canonical QA.
